source: Owner message in a Claude chat (community article lane, joel-articles) on 2026-10-12 at 17:23 UTC, after the assistant's final message named a report by a path relative to a lane folder.
owner_statement: can you stop giving me paths to files that are relative to something? send that bug report to UDA i thought i told you always give me a link to click or a file to look at
problem: A final message told the owner the reasoning was in `sweep-20261012/SWEEP-RESULTS.md`, a path relative to a folder inside a repository branch, which he couldn't open. The rule against this was loaded (patterns/human-readable-operational-references.md, Owner-facing artifact delivery; logic failure map LF-9.3), but it was prose applied from memory at the end of a long turn, and nothing checked the message.

recurring_finding.class: Owner-facing references he can't open (repository paths instead of a sent file or a link).
prior_fixes: Root AGENTS.md, Owner-facing artifact delivery (moved to patterns/human-readable-operational-references.md, 2026-09-26)
recurring_finding.redesign: A mechanical check of the draft message: scripts/owner_message_refs.py lists every path-like reference that is neither a link nor a file sent with the message; the pattern says to run it before a message names a file.

required_behavior: Before sending a message that points the owner to a file or document, run scripts/owner_message_refs.py on the draft with the sent files, or scan the draft by eye where the repository isn't checked out.
Each reference it lists is sent, replaced by a clickable link, or named in plain words.
authority: OWNER_REQUIRED. The delivery-priority rule in patterns/human-readable-operational-references.md is unchanged; this adds a check of the message that carries it.
scope: Every owner-facing message that names a file or document, on every surface under the universal architecture.

origin.notes: The owner asked for the bug report to go to UDA; the script and its wording are the assistant's implementation.

execution_surfaces.surface: Claude chats on claude.ai without this repository checked out
execution_surfaces.notes: The by-eye scan in the pattern applies there.
